Package org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint

Class RedisSaver.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.bsc.langgraph4j.checkpoint.RedisSaver.Builder
Enclosing class:
RedisSaver
public static class RedisSaver.Builder extends Object
A builder for RedisSaver.

Supports two configuration modes:

  1. Direct configuration: Set host, port, username, password, database
  2. Inject RedissonClient: Call redissonClient() to reuse an existing client
If redissonClient() is called, direct config options are ignored.

    • ttl

      public RedisSaver.Builder ttl(long ttl, TimeUnit ttlUnit)
      Sets the time-to-live (TTL) for stored keys.

      By default, TTL is -1 (never expire). Setting a TTL will automatically expire keys after the specified time, which can be useful for automatic cleanup.

      Note: TTL is applied to checkpoint keys and thread name lookup keys. The thread hash and checkpoints sorted set are not directly TTL'd to maintain consistency during the thread lifecycle.

      Parameters:
      ttl - time to live value, use -1 for no expiration (default)
      ttlUnit - time unit for the ttl (default: MINUTES)
      Returns:
      this builder

    • redissonClient

      public RedisSaver.Builder redissonClient(org.redisson.api.RedissonClient redissonClient)
      Sets the RedissonClient to reuse.

      If this method is called, direct configuration options (host, port, etc.) are ignored. The caller is responsible for managing the lifecycle of the provided client.

      Parameters:
      redissonClient - the RedissonClient to reuse (required)
      Returns:
      this builder
